description: Distritos Rodoviários is a dataset listed in Brazilian national spatial data infrastructure metadata catalogue (INDE), a metadata catalogue (CSW), published or maintained by Infraestrutura Nacional de Dados Espaciais (INDE). Mapa apontando os cinco Distritos Rodoviários e seus respectivos limites no Distrito Federal e suas dimensões territoriais Observação: O usuário deve respeitar as seguintes condições 1- Declarar ter plena ciência que o produto é de autoria do DER/DF. Coverage: Brasil. Its tags are Distrito Rodoviário, Rodovia, Estrada, Estrada Parque. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-csw-inde-portal.
